# GovJobWala

> GovJobWala is India's Smartest Government Job Platform. We provide the latest Sarkari jobs, admit cards, results, answer keys, and syllabus updates.

## Core Features
- Users can browse the latest government jobs across India (Central Govt, State Govt, Banking, Defence, SSC, UPSC, Railway, Police, etc).
- Jobs are updated daily with accurate vacancy counts, application dates, required qualifications, and selection processes.
- Candidates can create a "GovJobWala" profile to automatically check their eligibility against any job post.

## Site Structure
- Homepage: `https://govjobwala.com/` - Features trending categories, live updates, and a fast-filter grid.
- Job Listings: `https://govjobwala.com/jobs` - A powerful search engine to filter jobs by qualification, state, and category.
- Job Details: `https://govjobwala.com/jobs/[slug]` - Deep dive into a specific job's requirements, dates, and official notification links.

## Official Links
- Home: https://govjobwala.com
- Jobs: https://govjobwala.com/jobs
